Zero-cost trial sequencing verified 2026-08-17: BigQuery first (permanent free tier, 1 TiB scanned/month + 10 GB storage, plus $300/90-day new-customer credit - a full TPC-H SF100 sweep fits inside the free monthly TiB). Databricks Free Edition (free forever, serverless 2X-Small SQL warehouse, per-account daily quotas, LinkedIn verification raises limits) for SF1-SF10; use the paid trial only if quotas block SF100. Snowflake 30-day trial, $400 credits, no credit card - an X-Small warehouse is 1 credit/hour so a full SF100 load plus 22 queries costs a few credits; $400 covers SF100 and SF1000 many times over. Redshift Serverless $300 / 90 days (~800 RPU-hours). ClickHouse Cloud $300 / 30 days. Do NOT start the time-boxed trials (Snowflake, ClickHouse Cloud) until the harness is proven green on BigQuery and Databricks Free Edition, so no trial clock burns on debugging.

description:
REVALIDATED 2026-08-20. Public corpus still has zero warehouse platforms. No snowflake/databricks/bigquery files under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results.

Lowest-cost signups as of 2026-08-20 (email; no paid plan required to start):
- Databricks Free Edition (free): https://www.databricks.com/learn/free-edition
- Snowflake 30-day trial, \$400 credits, email only: https://signup.snowflake.com/
- Google Cloud trial \$300 / 90 days plus BigQuery free tier 1 TiB queries/month: https://cloud.google.com/free

After credentials exist, run one TPC-H per warehouse and submit. Do not add PLATFORM_GROUPS or a cloud release-gate before a published result. This is independent of Explorer curated-preview launch.

anti_patterns.dont: Fix adapter configuration defects inline during the run
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD capture them in w8 and route them to the cloud-config item
anti_patterns.why: the run is the evidence-gathering exercise and inline fixes lose the friction record

anti_patterns.dont: Publish a cloud result without recording warehouse size, region and instance class
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD populate the deployment fields or do not publish
anti_patterns.why: a cloud number without its deployment metadata is not comparable and invites the vendor-benchmark criticism this project exists to avoid

anti_patterns.dont: Treat a green unit-test suite as evidence a cloud adapter works
anti_patterns.why: Snowflake, Databricks and BigQuery already have 351/458/349 unit tests and have never executed against a real endpoint

anti_patterns.dont: add PLATFORM_GROUPS or a cloud release-gate before any published warehouse result
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD publish one TPC-H bundle per warehouse first
anti_patterns.why: that is internal machinery, not the missing comparison page

item_meta.blocked_reason: Human-only cloud vendor signup (Databricks Free Edition, Snowflake trial, Google Cloud/BigQuery). Agent sessions must not invent credentials or create vendor accounts. After a human records that those accounts exist, unblock and resume w1-w5. Independent of corpus recency/restore work.

preserves.behavior: Cost control: a run is stopped at the recorded stop condition rather than allowed to overrun a trial credit
No credential ever reaches Git, a result bundle, a log, or a tracker note; cloud runs use environment variables or benchbox setup only

verifications.description: Cloud bundles present in the public corpus

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import duckdb;c=duckdb.connect('results-explorer/public/data/results.duckdb',read_only=True);print(c.execute('select deployment_class, count(*) from results group by 1').fetchall())"
verifications.description: Published cloud results carry real deployment metadata
verifications.expected: a non-local deployment_class appears; today all 207 rows are deployment_class=local

verifications.description: Cloud bundles validate and rank like any other
verifications.expected: pass, with the cloud bundles ranking-eligible

work_units.evidence: 2026-08-20: corpus platforms still DuckDB/DataFusion/Polars/Spark/SQLite/LakeSail/ClickHouse Local only; rg of ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/results found zero snowflake/databricks/bigquery files

work_units.summary: Sign up for Google Cloud trial ($300/90d + BigQuery 1 TiB/month free tier) at https://cloud.google.com/free and record that a BigQuery project exists
Run one TPC-H on BigQuery and keep the result bundle
Sign up for Databricks Free Edition at https://www.databricks.com/learn/free-edition and run one TPC-H
Sign up for Snowflake 30-day trial ($400 credits) at https://signup.snowflake.com/ and run one TPC-H
Submit all cloud bundles through benchbox submit and merge to published-results
Optional after published results: add a cloud group to PLATFORM_GROUPS. Does not block w5 or v0.4.0
DECISION GATE - before any paid signup, decide the per-warehouse scale and stop condition (scale factor, max spend, max wall clock) and record it; abort a run that exceeds it rather than continuing
Record every configuration failure hit on the way to a first successful connection, and file them against cloud-config-error-messages-give-broken-instructions rather than fixing them inline
